svg.title: Toy Town layout
svg.text: TOY TOWN · Toy Town · 64x42 tiles · road 3 tiles wide
Lap 200 tiles = 25,567 px · about 30 s per lap · closest the road comes to itself: 5.9 tiles · bridge crossing at 90°
Dashed white = racing line. Pink = mid-lap checkpoint. Pale blue on the road = ice. Orange = boost pad.
Kerbs wherever the bend is tight. Map edge is a wall. One faint square = one 128 px tile.
